titulo: DEVO v2 — Melissa, retrato em pose (meio corpo, ref. Persona)
prompt: Bold clean anime lineart, two-tone cel shading, high-contrast graphic poster style. Half-body portrait from mid-thigh up, plain flat medium grey background, headroom above the head. A slender young woman in her early twenties leans forward in three-quarter view as if greeting someone at a door, head tilted, warm half-lidded violet eyes, small open smile; her right hand held out palm up toward the viewer, relaxed hand, five fingers clearly separated; her left hand holds a plain unmarked black leather folder at her hip. Platinum blonde asymmetrical bob with visible forehead, longer lock on the viewer's left, the other side tucked behind the ear with a large blue rose and long black ribbon on the viewer's right. Fitted royal cobalt-blue pinstriped blazer with puffed shoulders and black lapels; short black capelet lined in amethyst veined like marble; white ruffled jabot and thin black tie; wide white lace bell cuffs; blue rose corsage with a silver eye on the chest on the viewer's right. Clean soft frontal light, pale blue rim light. Palette: black #0C0C0E, cobalt blue #4A6CF0, amethyst #8A7CC8. No text, letters or logos anywhere.
negative: text, letters, watermark, logo, blurry, low detail, pixel art, extra fingers, extra limbs
